name: Jayatma Enterprises Limited
about: Jayatma Enterprises Limited provides warehousing rental services in India. It also trades in raw cotton bales and other textile products. The company was formerly known as Jayatma Spinners Limited and changed its name to Jayatma Enterprises Limited in November 2018. Jayatma Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
